event.text: Please be seen in person today — urgent care or an emergency department — for your worsening breathlessness and green phlegm. You need your oxygen level checked, a lung exam and likely a chest X-ray, which messaging can't provide. Call 911 immediately if you struggle to speak in full sentences, your lips or fingers turn blue, or you become drowsy or confused.
